message: Charlie, I'm figuring that copyright-until-it's-published-under-a-CC-license notice is there for a reason, and it's more a question of respect for the writer: I imagine if you want to publish it unrevised, you will, and that's where I defer to you. For me, it's not so much an issue of "can" as it is a question of "will". But I did a little revision, and it's up as my new entry, and I did indeed reference what you wrote a couple times, in a way that I think manages to respect the integrity of your work. Guess I'll see what you have to say. :)
